prerequisite_graph.rule: all prerequisites point to lower-numbered cards; recall cards are roots; application cards depend on paired recall where available

quality_changes: Rebuilt 247 cyclic prerequisite components (879 cards affected in pre-audit graph) into an acyclic graph.
Added dedicated objective 2.3 cards for assessments, scanning, and metrics rather than mapping all three to the parent control-effectiveness card.
Disambiguated duplicate card fronts for encryption, financial, and hardening across different objectives.
Strengthened Layer 8 with authoritative technical references for non-acronym cards that previously cited only the CompTIA scope document where a suitable source exists.
Preserved the eight-layer retrieve-first structure and original hard practice/PBQ banks.
limitations: CompTIA states the objective examples are non-exhaustive, so published-blueprint completeness is not a live-item-bank guarantee.
The protected live exam item bank cannot be legitimately audited.
No internal review can provide a literal pass guarantee; application skill must be validated with unseen scenario/PBQ practice.
Standards, product terminology, and regulations can change after the audit date.
